channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Markieff Morris | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Markieff Morris from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Josh Giddey on Markieff Morris
item.description:
“First, I was ready to get out of there because it was obviously a long year for a number of reasons, but you’re just sitting there with your thoughts for 15 hours, and the Wi-Fi was down so I couldn’t even pass time on my phone. I was just there thinking, and I remembered one of the Morris twins (Markieff) came up to me before I left and said, ‘You’re too good to let that happen to you.’ “From that point on my mind has been the next time I get to the postseason, what happened in that playoff series is never going to happen again.”

Josh Giddey on Markieff Morris, Apr 7, 2025. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris
item.description:
“Me and Kyrie, we matchin’ up. I’m taking [Bradley Beal] over [JR Smith]. You got [LeBron James] over Trevor Ariza. Kevin Love and Markieff Morris, I’m taking Kevin Love but Markieff Morris can shoot threes and post up. I’m taking [Marcin] Gortat over Tristan Thompson,”

John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Markieff Morris, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Spo on the fallout of the Jokic-Morris fight ahead of tonight's game:

“It's in the rearview mirror. I'm sure the NBA sent their security... but nothing is gonna happen.”

Erik Spoelstra on Markieff Morris, Nikola Jokic, Nov 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Coach Spo on Morris’ status (neck):

“He’s moving around in the locker room right now. We’ll do the necessary tests and do what we need to do make sure he’s ok.”

Erik Spoelstra on Markieff Morris, Nov 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @MiamiHEAT.

item.title: LeBron James on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Kyle Goon:LeBron on Danny and Markieff:

“They’re vets. I don’t think too much needs to be said to them. ... I’m not even saying they played bad tonight.”

LeBron James on Markieff Morris, Oct 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: LeBron James on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Though Morris scored just two points in the second half, his driving layup off a pass from Rajon Rondo tied the score at 94-94, putting the Lakers in a situation in which they never lost the lead again.

“Markieff was spectacular off the bench, giving us that instant offense with just his grit,”

LeBron James on Markieff Morris, Sep 7, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Markieff Morris, Seth Curry
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Markieff Morris tugging on Seth Curry’s shorts on the final play of Monday’s game:

“I didn’t like it. Didn’t like it, but you learn from it and move on.”

Scott Brooks on Markieff Morris, Seth Curry, Oct 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Paul Millsap on Markieff Morris
item.description:
“I can't let nobody come out and just push me around.(Morris) was more physical than me tonight, and if that's how we're going to play, that's how we're going to play. I've got to do a better job at that.”

Paul Millsap on Markieff Morris, Apr 16, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Devin Booker on Markieff Morris
item.description:
“They had me doing everything. When Markieff (Morris) was here, he would send me at 2 a.m. to go get some chips at CVS.”

Devin Booker on Markieff Morris, Mar 23, 2017. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Jorge Castillo:Ernie Grunfeld on Markieff Morris:

“Obviously what happened in Phoenix happened and everybody is going to try to put it behind them... And he’s going to have a clean slate as he comes here with us.”

Ernie Grunfeld on Markieff Morris, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @jorgeccastillo.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Michael Lee:Ernie Grunfeld on Markieff:

“We needed someone who would play with somewhat of a chip on his shoulder & had something to prove.”

Ernie Grunfeld on Markieff Morris, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Jorge Castillo:Jared Dudley on Markieff Morris:

“Some of the stuff he did was unprofessional, but that being said, I guarantee you will have no problems w/him here.”

Jared Dudley on Markieff Morris, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @jorgeccastillo.

item.title: Earl Watson on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Paul Coro:Earl Watson:

“I'm going to nurture and embrace Markieff Morris. I'm embracing him. We need him.”

Earl Watson on Markieff Morris, Feb 2, 2016. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Markieff Morris
item.description:
“He realized that he got a little emotional and that the behavior was not acceptable. Obviously, since we traded his brother over the summer, things haven't gone the way we hoped they would go on or off the court. I'm not going to sit here and beat up Markieff Morris for a bad moment. I think he regrets it.”

Ryan McDonough on Markieff Morris, Dec 24, 2015. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Eric Bledsoe on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Paul Coro:Eric Bledsoe on Markieff Morris:

“I guess people got misled about him as a teammate ... He's a great teammate. He's like my brother.”

Eric Bledsoe on Markieff Morris, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Paul Coro:McDonough on not alerting Morris of trade:

“We don't run it by them to get their opinion. That's not something we have done...”

Ryan McDonough on Markieff Morris, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Paul Coro:Tyson Chandler on Markieff Morris:

“I think all this stuff will be behind him. This isn't the first time a player had miscommunication with management.”

Tyson Chandler on Markieff Morris, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Archie Goodwin on Marcus Morris, Markieff Morris
item.description:
“He's a really positive guy to me and for everybody else. He's always been a team-first guy. I love Markieff. I love Marcus. I hope (Markieff) stays with us. I don't know what's going to happen with that situation. That's why I really can't speak on it. I really enjoy being around him and I wish the best for him whether he is with us or another team.”

Archie Goodwin on Marcus Morris, Markieff Morris, Aug 11, 2015. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Archie Goodwin on Markieff Morris
item.description:
No member of the Suns had addressed the idea that Markieff may want to leave until Suns guard Archie Goodwin spoke to SiriusXM NBA Radio on Monday.

“I can't speak too much on that situation but I can say that the last couple years I've been with (him), Markieff is a great guy, one of my favorite guys to be around,”

Archie Goodwin on Markieff Morris, Aug 11, 2015. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Leon Rose on Marcus Morris, Markieff Morris
item.description:
Ramona Shelburne:The Morris twins agent Leon Rose says, in a statement:

“Markieff and Marcus are good men and I am confident that when all the facts come out, their names will be cleared.”

Leon Rose on Marcus Morris, Markieff Morris, Apr 21, 2015. Source: Twitter @ramonashelburne.

item.title: Lon Babby on Marcus Morris, Markieff Morris
item.description:
Suns PresidentLon Babby on the assault charges filed against the Morris twins:

“We are disappointed to learn that Marcus and Markieff Morris have been charged. This is a serious matter, and we will treat it as such. However, at this time, we think it is most appropriate to continue to monitor the legal process as it unfolds before responding further.”

Lon Babby on Marcus Morris, Markieff Morris, Apr 21, 2015. Source: Twitter @ramonashelburne.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Eric Bledsoe, Markieff Morris
item.description:
and ,of criticism that the Suns traded their best player, McDonough said,

“My response would be that Eric Bledsoe and Markieff Morris still are in Phoenix Suns uniforms.”

Ryan McDonough on Eric Bledsoe, Markieff Morris, Feb 20, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Markieff Morris
item.description:
Mark Berman:Marcus Morris on trade to Suns/joining twin Markieff:

“Excited, Excited. It's a blessing to be back with my brother. Shocked, but blessed.”

Marcus Morris on Markieff Morris, Feb 20, 2013. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Jared Dudley, Robin Lopez, Markieff Morris
item.description:
“We have to continue to get improvement out of our young players like Markieff (Morris). I think Jared Dudley has made improvements. We have to get Robin (Lopez) to the point where he's consistently playing (well). I don't think we're a championship team. But I definitely think with the addition of a couple of guys here and there in free agency, we can get back in the mix and be a factor, for sure.”

Alvin Gentry on Jared Dudley, Robin Lopez, Markieff Morris, May 31, 2012. Source: Arizona Republic.
